While Bessent is pushing greater use of debt-management tools to support longer-term bonds, Warsh favours conventional rate policy and less intervention, as fiscal deficits continue to pressure Treasury yields.

title: US Stock Market: Jackson Hole Symposium in focus as investors seek clarity on Fed policy
description: Investors are turning to Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s first Jackson Hole speech for clues on the U.S. central bank’s rate path, as elevated inflation and rising Treasury yields complicate the policy outlook. Markets are seeking greater clarity on the Fed’s inflation target and the role of bond yields in tightening financial conditions.

title: German auto parts maker Mahle said to revisit IPO for India unit
description: German auto parts maker Mahle GmbH is revisiting plans to list its Indian business in Mumbai, according to people familiar with the matter. The potential IPO could raise around $300 million to $400 million, with the company expected to appoint advisers and begin preparations soon. Mahle had previously considered an India listing in 2024 but did not proceed.

title: Global Market | Shein set to raise $1.7 billion in Hong Kong IPO at $26.5 billion valuation: Reports
description: Shein is expected to price its Hong Kong IPO near HK$48.56 per share, raising about $1.7 billion at a $26.5 billion valuation. The listing marks a major milestone after years of regulatory challenges. Despite strong investor demand, Shein faces slower growth, shrinking margins, higher trade costs and increasing competition globally.

title: Bill Gates lists 3 big risks to AI shift. Is the world heading towards turbulent times?
description: Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates has warned that the AI transition could become one of the most turbulent periods in history, with the technology potentially widening inequality. He called for greater preparation for its social, political and economic impact and said he would support credible efforts to slow AI development globally.

title: Euro zone bond yields tick up after oil rises on Hormuz doubts
description: On Thursday, bond yields in the euro zone experienced a modest uptick. Meanwhile, oil prices rebounded slightly from their recent declines, impacting overall market sentiment. Diplomatic negotiations surrounding the Strait of Hormuz are ongoing, despite mixed signals from involved parties. Traders appear to anticipate minimal additional monetary tightening from the European Central Bank. Concerns over inflation and spending have pushed bond yields to levels not seen in several years.

title: Pushp Brand gets Sebi nod for IPO; A91 Partners, Sixth Sense to partially divest stake
